subject: Animation
title: Ursula: The Sea Witch's Power
description: A micro-lesson that makes Ursula: The Sea Witch's Power usable.

hook.text: Ursula from The Little Mermaid was inspired by the drag queen Divine — bold, theatrical, and unapologetically large.

buildup.text: Her body language dominates every scene — she commands the frame while Ariel shrinks beside her.

discovery.text: Poor Unfortunate Souls is a masterclass in villain songwriting — Ursula sells a terrible deal with charm.

twist.text: Ursula weaponizes a contract. She is a predatory businessperson, not a monster — making her danger feel modern.

climax.text: Ursula showed that the best villains are the ones who make you almost agree with them before you realize the trap.

punchline.text: The scariest villains are the ones who sound reasonable.

quiz.question: What real-world figure inspired Ursula's character design?
options: The drag queen Divine, giving Ursula bold, theatrical, and larger-than-life energy
